name: Laravel
server: Nginx with PHP-FPM, as in Laravel's deployment documentation
workers: Nginx: BENCH_WORKERS (2) workers; PHP-FPM: pm = static with pm.max_children = DB_POOL_SIZE (16) processes
database_layer: Eloquent (pdo_pgsql); a new connection for every request, no persistent PDO connections (Laravel's default; at most 16 open, one per PHP-FPM process)
logging: none (Nginx and PHP-FPM access logs off; Laravel logs warnings and errors to stderr)

phase2.validation: whereNumber('id') (404); $request->validate (422; integer:strict for the JSON body; an invalid form post is redirected back, 302)

csrf.mechanism: PreventRequestForgery (web group): Sec-Fetch-Site same-origin accepted, else the session's _token field; 419

session.mechanism: session guard with the cookie session driver (Laravel's default database driver is not used: decision 4, pending; see README.md)

structure_note: Nginx (2 workers) and PHP-FPM (16 processes) share the 2 vCPUs
notes: php artisan optimize runs at start-up. The web group (/html, /form, /login, /me) uses the cookie session driver, not Laravel's default database driver: the load sends /html no cookies, so the database driver would insert a sessions row on every /html request (decision 4 of docs/v3-spec.md, pending the maintainer's confirmation).
database_note: opens a new PostgreSQL connection for every request (PHP-FPM; Laravel's documentation does not recommend persistent PDO connections)
